Container.Name: Get Icon
Container.Overview: Extract, inspect, convert and download the highest-quality icon from any public website. Get Icon analyzes Apple Touch Icons, Web App Manifests, regular favicons and common paths, then verifies real formats and dimensions. Includes batch extraction, multilingual UI, image conversion, caching, rate limiting and SSRF protection.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: favicon icon logo website manifest n8n agent extractor
Container.Requires: Outbound HTTP and HTTPS access to the public websites you want to analyze.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the Get Icon web interface and REST API.

Config.Name: Allow DNS fake-IP
Config.Description: Keep false on normal networks. Enable only for a trusted Clash 198.18.0.0/15 fake-IP DNS environment.

Config.Name: Max outbound requests
Config.Description: Maximum concurrent outbound website and icon requests shared by all users.

Config.Name: API rate limit
Config.Description: Maximum API requests per client IP per minute.

Config.Name: Trusted proxy hops
Config.Description: Trusted reverse proxy hop count. Keep 1 for a single Caddy or Nginx proxy.
